name: Firstlink
summary: Sydney dialup + hosting + game zone ISP (First Link Communications Pty Ltd, George St, by 1997); the same trading name also registered 1997 as First Link Internet Services Pty Ltd (PO Box 4753, North Rocks NSW). By Jun 2003 the site served a Chinese-language (Big5) ISP at Haymarket/Chinatown ('第一網絡') self-described 'Founded in 1996'. Defunct c. 2003. NOTE: this is a DIFFERENT legal entity from the current 'First Link' business ISP on the same domain — that is First Link Pty Ltd (ex-Join Internet Corporation Pty Ltd, ACN 079 681 164), which adopted the name/domain from 2010 (see isps-draft/first-link-pty-ltd.json).
